Class ToothRecords

  • java.lang.Object
    • ToothRecords
  • public class ToothRecords
extends java.lang.Object
    Records the teeth of the members of a Floridian family for the Florida Dental Association. Each tooth is an Incisor ('I'), a Bicuspid ('B'), or Missing ('M'). The teeth are stored in a three dimensional array of characters: one plane per person, two rows (uppers and lowers), and one column per tooth.
    Version:
    1.0
    Author:
    Ciara Escalante

      • extractTooth

        private static void extractTooth​(java.lang.String[] names,
                                 char[][][] teeth)

        Parameters:
        names - The family members' names
        teeth - The family's teeth, updated with the extraction

      • reportRootCanals

        private static void reportRootCanals​(char[][][] teeth)
        Reports the family's root canal indices, the roots of Ix2 + Bx - M, where I, B, and M are the family's numbers of incisors, bicuspids, and missing teeth. The discriminant B2 + 4IM is never negative, so the roots are always real.
        Parameters:
        teeth - The family's teeth
